name: The Field household at 1919 Prairie Avenue
head: pa1904_field_marshall_jr

present_on_scene_date.note: Listed at 1919 Prairie Avenue in the Blue Book for 1904 (canvass begun September 1903) and again in the 1905 edition (canvass begun September 1904), which bracket 1 July 1904. The 1905 list prints: 1919 Mr. & Mrs. Marshall Field jr..

associated_with.note: The Blue Book's Prairie Avenue street list prints the household at 1919, and the 1905 list again. The book gives no date the household came or went, so neither end is dated here.

not_in_this_household.note: WHO IS NOT ON THIS CARD, AND WHY. The Blue Book is a society register: it names the family members who received and were received, prints unmarried daughters only as '& dr.', and names no young children, servants, coachmen, cooks or nurses. In 1900 Leroy W. Fuller lived here, not Marshall Field jr. The census says nothing about this household's staff. The children the Blue Book lists at the number from 1890 to 1911 are on the card with the years each was listed, whether or not they were at home in 1904. The 1910 census was not read for this card. A person goes on this card when a source names them, and not before.

portrait_research.note: An individual portrait has not yet been verified in the period portrait books and Glessner House Museum article archive searched for this project. Any figure shown is a reconstruction, not an attested likeness.

persons.name: Albertine Huck Field

born.note: Provisional year from a compiled genealogy; no primary birth record inspected.

portrait.caption: Albertine Huck Field, Chicago Sunday Tribune, 3 March 1907, p. 4. MSU Libraries. Published three years after the scene.
portrait.why: Captioned on the original newspaper page; the modeled face uses the inferred 1904 age, with unseen depth and colours reconstructed.
